Ho Chi Minh City | continentalcup1 = [[2010 AFC Champions League]] | continentalcup1 qualifiers = Da Nang | continentalcup2 = [[2010 AFC Cup]] | continentalcup2 qualifiers = Bình Dương | continentalcup3 = | continentalcup3 qualifiers = | league topscorer = | biggest home win = | biggest away win = | highest scoring = | total goals = | average goals = | longest wins = | longest unbeaten = | longest losses = | highest attendance = | lowest attendance = | average attendance = | prevseason = [[2008 V-League|2008]] | nextseason = [[2010 V-League|2010]] }} The '''2009 V-League''' was the 26th season of [[V.League 1|Vietnam's national football league]] and the 9th as a professional league.. The league was held from February 7, 2009 to August 23, 2009. The league winners qualify for the [[AFC Champions League]] qualifying round in 2010. The cup winners enter the [[AFC Cup]]. The bottom two sides at the end of the season get relegated. The side that finishes 3rd from bottom enters an end of season play-off match against the 2nd Division's 3rd placed side. == Managerial changes == {| class="wikitable" |- ! Team ! Outgoing manager !
